title: SYNTHETIC routing fixture: verify experiment record plumbing
hypothesis: The hand-authored synthetic routing rule will report accuracy above the constant status-label fixture baseline; this is only an infrastructure demonstration.
rival_explanation: The rules and data generator were authored together, so any apparent gain follows from fixture construction and is not evidence of generalizable agent capability.
experimental_unit: One synthetic routing case; repeats from different seeds are generated fixtures, not independent real users.

data_split.development: Hand-authored generator and rules in examples/tiny_agent_experiment.py.
data_split.evaluation: 60 synthetic labels generated separately within each declared seed; no real held-out benchmark is claimed.
data_split.leakage_controls: No valid scientific holdout: the generator and rule share author knowledge. This deliberate limitation must remain visible.

controls: Use the same generated labels for the rule and constant-label fixture baseline.
Keep synthetic=true on the plan, execution record, and imported results.
baselines: A constant status-label prediction, used only as a plumbing fixture.

decision_thresholds.success: Infrastructure demonstration only: exit code 0, finite accuracy between 0 and 1, and preserved logs; scientific support is not assessed.
decision_thresholds.failure: Fixture execution fails, is timed out, produces non-finite imported metrics, or record checks fail; preserve the evidence.
decision_thresholds.inconclusive: Every outcome remains inconclusive about real agent effectiveness, novelty, and publication readiness.

notes: Run this example from a copy of the repository containing examples/tiny_agent_experiment.py. Resolve python3 for your machine before freezing. No network calls or model inference are used.
